rules.controls: Import initComponents once for the app; it draws the prev/next buttons and one dot per page for every mounted Carousel root, including this React binding.
rules.behavior: Configure loop, autoplay, orientation, controls and mouse-drag with plain data-* attributes forwarded through Carousel's own props (see consume.vanilla for the exact names).
rules.label: Pass aria-label to name the region for assistive tech; the track and slides otherwise carry no label of their own.
rules.goto: Use the Carousel ref's snapTo(index) to jump to a slide programmatically instead of scrolling the track manually.
